vlc.note: The official VLC 3.0.24 build for 64-bit Windows. Its sha256 matches VideoLAN's own vlc-3.0.24-win64.zip.sha256. STX ships libvlc.dll, libvlccore.dll and the plugins below, nothing else from the zip.

excludePlugins.gui: VLC's own windows; STX has its own console
excludePlugins.control: remote control, hotkeys and the Windows service: STX drives LibVLC itself
excludePlugins.lua: site scripts and extensions stay off (--no-lua); web links use STX's capture path
excludePlugins.services_discovery: network and media discovery would open ports and browse the network
excludePlugins.stream_out: streaming out would open network ports
excludePlugins.access_output: writes streams out to the network or files
excludePlugins.misc/libaudioscrobbler_plugin.dll: sends what you play to Last.fm

dvdPlugins.note: Shipped for unencrypted DVDs (Rocky, Phase 4; spec assumption A5). Both have libdvdcss built in, which decrypts CSS. STX never lets them see an encrypted disc: Stx.Core.Playback.DiscCheck refuses one before LibVLC is given it.

soundFont.note: FluidR3_GM by Frank Wen, MIT license (see the copyright file shipped beside it). LibVLC's FluidSynth needs a SoundFont to play MIDI.
